fusions.name: Pinning Paw
fusions.desc: Slams a paw down on an enemy for 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second, leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and stripping 10% of its armour for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Herding Swipes
fusions.desc: Swipes all around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Run
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, freezes every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, then leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Toying with the Caught
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
